dataset.security.no_arbitrary_code: dataset specs are data-only msgspec structs with no expr/code/url field; no arbitrary-code path exists
dataset.transform.ops_allowed: the dataset transform tagged union admits only select/filter/group_by/aggregate/sort
dataset.transform.aggregates_match_recomputation: the dataset renderer inlines only recomputed data.values; no model-value path exists
dataset.transform.filters_declared: every dataset filter is a declared transform.filter op and the verifier recomputes declared transforms only
dataset.derived_value_mismatch: DROPPED: dataset specs supply no plotted values, so a derived-value lie is impossible by construction

formula.security.no_arbitrary_code: formula text can reach evaluation only through the closed verifier-owned AST interpreter; this path never executes it as Python
formula.formula.points_from_recomputation: the verifier-owned evaluator produces the sampled table; formula specs carry no candidate point values
formula.formula.rounding_unambiguous: the rational-half-even-v1 profile fixes one HALF_EVEN rule applied deterministically to x and y quantization

dataset.sort.canonical_order: SMT checks the exact built dataset row sequence against the active declared sort plus canonical tail before native Vega
dataset.scale.bar_zero: SMT checks every exact built quantitative dataset bar channel carries scale.zero=true before native Vega
dataset.encoding.legend_domain_exact: SMT checks each exact built dataset discrete color domain has complete, no-extra set equality with its plotted non-null categories before native Vega

formula.sort.canonical_order: SMT checks exact FormulaEvidence x ranks are nondecreasing in ascending order; equality is allowed and evaluator sampling alone establishes strict increase
formula.scale.bar_zero: inapplicable: formula mode admits only line/scatter and has no bar baseline
formula.encoding.legend_domain_exact: inapplicable: formula mode has no color channel or legend domain
